v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: De manu ómnium * qui odérunt nos, liberávit nos Dóminus.
text.en: From the hand of all * who hate us, the Lord has delivered us.

text.la: Protéctor in te sperántium, Deus, sine quo nihil est válidum, nihil sanctum; multíplica super nos misericórdiam tuam; ut, te rectóre, te duce, sic transeámus per bona temporália, ut non amittámus ætérna.
text.en: O God, the protector of all them that trust in thee, without whom nothing is strong, nothing is holy; increase and multiply upon us thy mercy, that thou being our ruler and guide, we may so pass through things temporal, that we finally lose not the things eternal.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Fac nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Primi et Feliciáni semper festa sectári: quorum suffrágiis protectiónis tuæ dona sentiámus.
text.en: Make us, O Lord, we beseech thee, ever heartily to rejoice over thine holy martyrs Primus and Felician, and grant to us at their prayer the gift of thy safe-keeping.

office.title: Feria quarta infra Hebd III post Octavam Pentecostes
